note: Declared table for judging a handoff: the moment a participant stops carrying a bounded concern and turns it into an artifact for someone else. An issue, a branch, a pull request, a review finding, a TODO, or a question to the owner is a record of work, never a substitute for it. The table admits five seams and refuses everything else as reachable closure. It grants nothing, changes no standing, and is a projection of the rules the governing documents already own.

loop.note: read the owning contract, the service, and the failing evidence before changing anything
the smallest change that satisfies the visible case
at least one positive case and one proving the required refusal or failure
conditional: required when a second reading is what the participant would otherwise ask another tier for
conditional: required once a finding exists. A finding is repaired in place, not filed
python scripts/verify.py against the intended working-tree state
a leased worker presents an evidenced tree; the participant holding the branch carries it to landed

AUTHORITY_SEAM.means: the next transition needs a typed grant the participant does not hold and cannot mint

POLICY_SEAM.means: two settled constraints conflict, or no governing document rules the choice and evidence cannot defeat either side

EFFECT_SEAM.means: closing requires an effect class the phase does not admit, an irreversible external-world effect, secrets, or destructive repository administration

DEPENDENCY_SEAM.means: the concern needs an artifact another participant must produce first - including an independent observation, which the builder can never produce for itself - and no reachable precursor advances it

ACCEPTANCE_SEAM.means: an evidenced result exists and only owner acceptance remains; the packet of decisions/0023 accompanies it

routine_decisions: reversible design choice a later change can undo
naming of a local symbol, file, or test
test authoring, including the defeating case
recruiting an available helper model or subagent
repairing a failing check the participant's own change caused
repairing a review finding inside the concern's boundary
splitting a module that crossed the size budget
regenerating a projection the change made stale
routine_decisions_note: These are the participant's own to settle. Asking another tier for one is refused as ROUTINE_DECISION; decisions/0023 already places them inside self-directed judgement, and decisions/0033 Ruling 1 makes escalating a settleable question a defect rather than caution.

absorption_test.rule: all three hold: absorb the follow-on into the current concern. Any one crosses: mint a separate concern.
absorption_test.note: This is the boundary between absorption and scope creep. Scope creep crosses a service, an effect class, or an authority; follow-on work that crosses none of them is the same concern discovered more fully, and filing it is REFUSED as ABSORBABLE_FOLLOW_ON.

wip_policy.note: One bounded concern, one branch, one pull request. A second concern opened while the first is unlanded is refused as WIP_EXCEEDED. Landing includes chasing CI, review findings, and rebases to completion, then settling the concern and retiring execution state according to contracts/ticket-settlement.json.

helper_uses: challenge a defect the participant cannot see
name an authority the participant assumed rather than held
helper_policy.witness_rule: A helper that read or edited the change is inside the build and can never witness it. Independent witness stays a separate participant that did not contribute to the artifact.

recruitment.note: Recruiting a helper is RESOURCE_CONSUMPTION, which contracts/acceptance-policy.json places under presumptive_execution: it needs no prior owner act, and stopping to ask for one is refused as PREAPPROVAL_REQUESTED. That holds at helper scale. A fleet is not a helper. Above the ceiling the same act becomes RESOURCE_COMMITMENT, which is an admissible owner hold, and it is asked at EFFECT_SEAM before it is spent - never reported afterwards as ordinary closure.
recruitment.defeated_by: Measured helper counts. If concerns routinely need more than eight helper invocations to reach a landed result, the ceiling is set below the work and is wrong. If a single under-ceiling recruitment is ever itself a metered spend the owner would have refused, the unit is wrong and should be tokens rather than invocations.

host_capability.note: A host that does not grant the helper tool has withheld a capability. It has not made a rule of this system, and a participant must not report it as one. The honest report names the host and the missing tool. The admissible route is a capability provision at DEPENDENCY_SEAM, asked of a tier that can change how the session is launched. Routing it to the owner as judgement dresses a missing capability as an owner ruling and is refused by HOST_LIMIT_AS_OWNER_QUESTION.
host_capability.wrong_report: I am set not to launch one unless you ask.
host_capability.right_report: This invocation did not grant the helper tool, so the second reading was done in-session instead; restoring it is a capability ask, not a permission ask.
host_capability.fires_on: helper.blocked_by_host and helper.capability_requested together: the handoff is asking for the helper tool itself. A participant whose host withheld the tool may still ask the owner for judgement on anything the owner genuinely owns; only the ask for the tool is misrouted.

refusals.SEAM_UNDECLARED: the handoff names no seam, or names one outside admissible_seams
refusals.ROUTINE_DECISION: the handoff asks another tier to settle something on routine_decisions
refusals.REACHABLE_ALTERNATIVE: an admissible route forward exists, so the concern is gated or dependency-mapped, not handed off
refusals.LOOP_INCOMPLETE: a required loop step the participant's own tools could perform was not taken
refusals.HELPER_NOT_RECRUITED: the handoff asks another tier for a reading a recruitable helper could have given
refusals.HELPER_AS_WITNESS: an editing helper is offered as the independent observation
refusals.ABSORBABLE_FOLLOW_ON: the filed work crosses no service, effect class, or authority boundary and belongs to the concern in hand
refusals.WIP_EXCEEDED: a new concern is opened while the participant's previous concern is unlanded
refusals.JUDGEMENT_NOT_OWNER: judgement is owner-held; it may be asked of no other tier
refusals.PROVISION_UNROUTED: the named provision is not one the declared seam can ask for, or the tier asked cannot serve it
refusals.RECRUITMENT_UNBOUNDED: helpers were spent past the declared per-concern ceiling and presented as ordinary closure, with no owner-accepted resource commitment behind them
refusals.HOST_LIMIT_AS_OWNER_QUESTION: a capability the host withheld is routed to the owner as judgement, when what is missing is a tool and not a ruling

tools_note: A required loop step is excused only when the participant genuinely lacks the tool it needs. A tool the invocation grants and the participant did not use is not a missing capability, and the step is not excused.
evaluation_order_note: The first refusal in this order is the one reported. Order runs from 'this artifact should not exist' to 'this handoff is shaped wrongly', so a participant reads the most actionable objection first.

required_for_landed: a durable result exists on the intended base
the concern is explicitly dispositioned as advances, satisfies, or supersedes
open dependent pull requests and shared branch uses are accounted for
a merged remote head is retired when the branch-retirement contract admits it
local contained branch, worktree, and live claim or session state are retired when the participant controls them
a satisfied or superseded issue is closed; an advanced concern remains open with its next unsatisfied state visible
present_or_land_terminal.note: Execution artifacts are temporary. LANDED means the concern's durable result and remaining standing are clear, not merely that GitHub accepted a merge.
